transcript.content: Hi, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?

Um... I guess I’ve been doing some weird things at work and school. Like, stuff that doesn’t really make sense. I’ll line receipts across the floor, or tap the calculator in nines. Sometimes I just stand by the copier with my hands up until someone asks if I’m okay. I don’t know. It’s been noticeable.
When you do these things, does it feel like you have to do them to relieve a strong uncomfortable thought or urge?
I don’t know. I wouldn’t say it’s like… a strong urge exactly. It just kind of happens, or feels like the thing I’m doing at the time. I haven’t really thought about it that way.
When this happens, does it ever feel like something outside you is making you do it?

Kind of. Not like a hand pushing me or anything. It’s more like… the numbers are telling me something. Like invoice totals or account numbers or due dates start feeling like messages about me, and I have to respond to the pattern. Even if my supervisor says they’re just normal entries, I still feel like they’re checking whether I understand it.
Have you been needing much less sleep than usual and still felt full of energy?

Yeah… sometimes. I’ve had a few nights where I only slept like two or three hours, and I still felt fine the next day. Like I should just get up and go to work or class because sleeping was kind of wasting time.
During those times when you slept only a few hours, did you feel unusually euphoric or high?

Not exactly euphoric, I guess. More like… some weeks I feel really sharp, like I can figure everything out and plan my whole future in one night. Kind of unstoppable. But I can also get irritated fast, like if my boss or someone in class corrects me, I’ll snap more than I meant to.
Do the times when numbers feel like messages about you happen only during those high-energy, little-sleep periods?

No… not only then. There was a few weeks where I was sleeping more normal, not really energized or anything, and it still happened. I still heard the voice sometimes and got pulled into the number patterns.
When you say you heard a voice sometimes, did it sound like an actual voice speaking to you?

Yeah… it does. Not like a thought exactly. Sometimes when I’m alone at my desk or walking home, I’ll hear a man’s voice say something like, “check line seven,” or “you missed the sign.” It’s clear enough that I look around, but there’s nobody there.
Have there been times when you were not feeling especially energized or irritable, but you were still hearing the voice?

Yeah… there was a stretch like that. A few weeks, I think. I was sleeping more normal and I didn’t feel all revved up, but I still heard it sometimes… and the numbers still felt like they were pulling me in.
At any time when you were not feeling unusually energized or irritable, did the voice and the number messages continue like that for at least one full month?

I’m not totally sure it was a full month. It was several weeks, at least… where I was sleeping more normal and wasn’t especially energized, but the voice still happened sometimes, and the numbers still felt like they meant something.
Have you ever had a period lasting at least one week when you felt unusually energized or irritable most of the day, nearly every day?

Yeah… I think so. There are some weeks where I feel really sharp, like I can figure everything out at once, and it’s most days. But I also get irritated easier… like if my boss corrects something small, I’ll snap more than I mean to.
During one of those high-energy or irritable weeks, were you ever hospitalized because of it?
No… not that I remember. I haven’t been hospitalized for one of those times.
During those high-energy or irritable weeks, were you more active than usual in starting projects or doing lots of tasks?

Yeah… I guess so. I’ll start a bunch of things at once, like making templates for every client, emailing people about a study group, even planning some bookkeeping service idea… before I’ve finished the work that’s already due.
During those high-energy or irritable weeks, were you talking much more than usual?
I’m not really sure. I don’t think I’m, like, talking nonstop or anything. Maybe a little more if I’m worked up, but I haven’t really noticed it.
During those high-energy times, did you feel like you had special abilities or were more important than usual?
Yeah… kind of. I don’t know if I’d say “important,” but I feel really sharp, like I can figure everything out all at once. Like I could plan my whole future in one night. It feels… bigger than usual.
During those high-energy weeks, did other people notice that you were acting unusually different from your normal self?

Yeah… I think so. People can tell I’m more intense, I guess. I’ll feel really sharp, like I can figure everything out, and then if my boss or someone corrects me, I can snap back harder than I meant to.
Have you ever stayed completely still or unable to move or speak for a long time, even when people were trying to get you to respond?
No… I don’t think so. I might get quiet sometimes, but not like stuck or unable to move.
During those high-energy weeks, were the voice and the number messages happening then too?

Yeah… during those weeks, it was happening too. When I wasn’t really sleeping and I felt like I had to start all these plans, I’d hear the voice, and the invoice numbers felt like they were… sending me messages.
During those high-energy times, did you believe you had a special power or unique mission that other people would say wasn’t true?

Yeah… kind of. I don’t know if I’d call it a power, but I start feeling like the invoice totals and account numbers, due dates… like they’re meant for me. Like I’m supposed to see the pattern. Even if my supervisor says they’re just normal entries, it still feels like they’re tracking whether I understand it.
Have you ever had the voice or the feeling that numbers were sending you messages continue for at least two weeks when you were not feeling unusually energized or irritable?

Yeah… I think so. There was a stretch where I was sleeping more normal and I wasn’t really all energized or anything, but the voice was still there sometimes, and the numbers still felt like they meant something. It went on for a few weeks.
Have you ever had a time when you felt so unusually energized or irritable that it caused major problems in your life or made other people think you needed emergency help?
Yeah… it caused problems. I failed an important course module, and at work my ledgers started coming back with pretty serious mistakes. I had to ask for help with stuff I used to finish on my own.

opening_question.intent: Learn the patient's main reason for seeking care today
opening_question.question: Hi, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?

final_diagnosis.reason: The patient has clear psychotic symptoms (auditory hallucinations and ideas/delusions of reference involving numbers) occurring both during mood episodes and for at least two weeks outside periods of elevated/irritable mood. They also describe a manic syndrome lasting at least one week with decreased need for sleep, increased activity, expansive/grandiose thinking, irritability, and functional deterioration. Psychosis is therefore not confined to mania, supporting schizoaffective disorder, manic type, over bipolar I disorder with psychotic symptoms.
